title: Completely free buttttt…
body:
Ok don’t get me wrong, this app is good. It’s free, it’s, designed to help people with ADHD, what’s not to love? Well as someone who finds it hard to focus (I might have adhd idk if I do) it’s kinda confusing. You can change the font and colour theme, but not a lot else. You can set focus sessions, and you can set tasks as well. However, there’s an option where you can block ALL OF YOUR APPS and GIVE YOURSELF A SCREEN TIME LIMIT FOR THEM ALL!!!!! I don’t really like that feature if you can’t tell. I know, I know, it’s optional, but if you truly have adhd it’s gonna be hard to resist tapping the button that says: OVERRIDE BLOCK IN FIVE SECONDS!
I mean come on

Sorry if you find this offensive 🥲

title: A lot of potential, but really buggy
body:
I think there’s a lot of great features in this app but it can also be pretty frustrating to use. For example, the repeat function (at least for weekly repeats) seems to be broken entirely. It either doesn’t repeat on the right day, doesn’t work at all, or doesn’t repeat on the right day and removes the task on the day I made it. Setting the time for each task is also pretty annoying because it likes to constantly pop up saying I set an impossible time, while I’m still adjusting it. The weekday view at the top also breaks a lot, when I’m on ‘today’ it’ll display dates that are wrong and it’ll only fix itself when I close and reload the app.

I love the focus timer feature, the brain dump feature, and a lot of other things about the app though, it just really needs more polishing.
